title: Here’s how much the AI boom is contributing to inflation, according to Goldman Sachs calculations
summary: Goldman Sachs has quantified the AI boom's contribution to inflation, providing economic insight into how rapid technological advancement affects price levels. Understanding AI's inflationary impact helps policymakers and investors assess the dual nature of technological progress on broader economic trends.
content: Goldman Sachs economists have calculated how much the AI boom has contributed to inflation.

zh.title: 高盛计算显示AI热潮对通胀的贡献有多大
zh.summary: 高盛量化了AI热潮对通胀的贡献，提供了对技术快速进步如何影响价格水平的经济见解。理解AI的通胀影响有助于政策制定者和投资者评估技术进步对更广泛经济趋势的双重影响。

title: Morgan Stanley is set to report earnings — here’s what to expect
summary: Morgan Stanley's earnings are expected to show strength driven by robust investment banking and equities trading revenue. Strong capital markets activity reflects investor confidence and broad economic expansion in financial services.
content: Morgan Stanley is expected to benefit from robust investment banking and equities trading revenue.

zh.title: 摩根士丹利将公布财报——以下是预期
zh.summary: 摩根士丹利的财报预期将显示由于强劲的投资银行和股票交易收入而表现强劲。强大的资本市场活动反映了投资者信心和金融服务领域的广泛经济扩张。

title: Bank of America posts third-quarter profit drop due to $1.2 billion Treasury fine
summary: Bank of America reported third-quarter profit declines following a $1.2 billion penalty from the U.S. Treasury Department over previous compliance issues. The fine underscores ongoing regulatory enforcement and its tangible impact on major financial institutions' profitability.
content: The U.S. Treasury Department announced a $1.2 billion penalty against Bank of America on Tuesday.

zh.title: 美国银行第三季度利润下滑，因美国财政部12亿美元罚款
zh.summary: 美国银行报告第三季度利润下滑，原因是美国财政部对其之前的合规问题处以12亿美元罚款。这项罚款强调了持续的监管执法及其对大型金融机构盈利能力的切实影响。

title: From Charles Schwab to DoorDash: Why these bargain stocks could lead the market higher
summary: HSBC analysis suggests third-quarter earnings growth could extend beyond energy and semiconductor leaders to include bargain stocks like Charles Schwab and DoorDash. This broadening of market gains would signal healthier overall economic expansion beyond traditional outperformers.
content: Third-quarter earnings growth is expected to be driven by energy and semiconductor companies, but what if the rest of the market shows up? HSBC envisages a stock market finally broadening out.

zh.title: 从Charles Schwab到DoorDash：这些便宜股票为何可能引领市场上升
zh.summary: 汇丰分析表明，第三季度盈利增长可能会从能源和半导体领先企业扩展到包括Charles Schwab和DoorDash等便宜股票。这种市场收益范围的扩大将预示着超越传统强势股票的更健康的整体经济扩张。

title: Job cuts could fund diesel price drop says deputy
summary: A UK deputy has proposed that job cuts could fund a freeze on diesel duty amid Middle East tensions driving fuel prices higher. The proposal reflects difficult trade-offs between employment levels and energy affordability during geopolitical crises.
content: With the ongoing war in the Middle East increasing prices, one deputy is ask for duty to be frozen.

zh.title: 副议员称裁员可能为柴油价格下降提供资金
zh.summary: 一位英国副议员提议，裁员可能为冻结柴油税提供资金，以应对中东局势紧张推高燃料价格。该提议反映了在地缘政治危机期间就业水平和能源可承受性之间的艰难权衡。

title: Wayfair among firms fined millions for misleading sales tactics
summary: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority fined Wayfair, Appliances Direct, and Gold's Gym a combined £6 million for misleading sales practices. The enforcement action demonstrates regulatory crackdowns on deceptive consumer marketing tactics across e-commerce and retail.
content: The Competition and Markets Authority has fined Wayfair, Appliances Direct, and Gold's Gym £6m in total.

zh.title: Wayfair等公司因误导性销售策略被罚数百万
zh.summary: 英国竞争和市场管理局因误导性销售行为对Wayfair、Appliances Direct和Gold's Gym处以总计600万英镑的罚款。这一执法行动表明监管机构对电子商务和零售业欺骗性消费者营销策略的打击。

title: Faisal Islam: What surprise praise for UK economy tells us about the Budget
summary: International Monetary Fund officials have unexpectedly praised UK plans to reduce borrowing levels in recent discussions. This external validation from a major multilateral institution suggests confidence in the UK's fiscal policy direction despite domestic economic challenges.
content: On three occasions in the past 24 hours, top IMF officials have praised UK plans to reduce its annual levels of borrowing.

zh.title: 法萨尔·伊斯兰：英国经济出人意料的赞扬对预算的启示
zh.summary: 国际货币基金组织官员在最近的讨论中意外称赞了英国减少借贷水平的计划。来自重要多边机构的这一外部认可表明，尽管存在国内经济挑战，但对英国财政政策方向充满信心。

title: Delta's business-class revamp: New seats, menus, plates and more Porsches
summary: Delta Air Lines is upgrading its premium Delta One cabin on A350 aircraft with new luxury suites, updated menus, and enhanced amenities starting next year. The investment reflects airlines' strategic focus on premium revenue growth as a competitive differentiator in a recovering market.
content: Delta is upgrading its top-tier Delta One cabin with new suites for its largest A350 plane, starting next year.

zh.title: 达美航空公司的商务舱改革：新座椅、菜单、餐具和更多保时捷
zh.summary: 达美航空公司将从明年开始升级A350飞机上的高级达美一号舱，配备新的豪华套房、更新的菜单和增强的便利设施。这项投资反映了航空公司在复苏的市场中将高端收入增长作为竞争差异化的战略重点。

title: Tech giants race to get AI gadgets on shelves for holiday rush
summary: Major technology companies are racing to launch AI-powered gadgets in time for holiday shopping, betting this year will finally drive mainstream consumer adoption. The acceleration reflects industry confidence in AI product commercialization and growing consumer readiness for intelligent devices.
content: With the holidays just a couple months away, tech companies are betting this is finally the year that AI gadgets make the shopping list.

zh.title: 科技巨头竞相在假期推出AI小工具
zh.summary: 主要科技公司竞相推出AI驱动的小工具，以赶上假期购物季，希望今年最终推动主流消费者采纳。这种加速反映了业界对AI产品商业化的信心和消费者对智能设备不断增长的认可度。

title: Even more borrowers choose riskier mortgages, as higher interest rates crush affordability
summary: Rising mortgage interest rates are pushing more homebuyers toward adjustable-rate mortgages to reduce immediate costs despite inherent long-term risks. This trend signals intensifying housing affordability pressures as rate increases price traditional homebuyers out of fixed-rate options.
content: Interest rates on mortgages continue to rise, leaving some buyers to choose riskier, adjustable-rate mortgages to find savings.

zh.title: 随着利率上升，更多借款人选择风险更高的抵押贷款
zh.summary: 不断上升的抵押贷款利率正促使更多购房者选择浮动利率抵押贷款以降低即期成本，尽管存在长期风险。这一趋势表明随着利率上升将传统购房者挤出固定利率选项，住房可负担性压力不断加剧。

title: Chili's owner has surged this year. It's still 'underappreciated,' Jefferies says
summary: Investment firm Jefferies upgraded Brinker International (Chili's parent) to buy from hold despite the stock surging this year. The call reflects analyst confidence that the casual dining sector remains undervalued with further recovery and growth potential.
content: The investment firm upgraded the restaurant stock to buy from hold.

zh.title: 芝乐坞母公司股价今年飙升，但杰弗瑞斯表示仍被"低估"
zh.summary: 投资公司杰弗瑞斯尽管股价今年大幅上涨，仍将餐饮国际公司（芝乐坞母公司）从持有升级为买入。这一评级反映了分析师的信心，认为休闲餐饮板块仍被低估，具有进一步复苏和增长的潜力。

title: BlackRock’s assets equal half the size of the U.S. economy after 15% growth
summary: BlackRock announced assets under management reached nearly $15.5 trillion following 15% annual growth, now equivalent to roughly half the U.S. GDP. The milestone underscores the asset management industry's growing influence over global capital flows and market dynamics.
content: Fund-management giant BlackRock said Wednesday that assets under management are nearly $15.5 trillion after growth of 15%.

zh.title: 贝莱德资产管理规模增长15%后达到美国经济规模的一半
zh.summary: 贝莱德宣布资产管理规模在年增长15%后达到近15.5万亿美元，约相当于美国GDP的一半。这一里程碑突显资产管理行业对全球资本流动和市场动态的影响力不断增加。

title: Diesel squeeze set to last well into 2027 as Iran war disrupts supply, IEA says
summary: The International Energy Agency projects diesel supply constraints will persist through 2027 due to Iran-related geopolitical disruption, falling inventories, and resilient demand. The extended shortage threatens transportation and industrial sectors that depend heavily on diesel fuel.
content: Diesel supply is expected to remain tight into 2027 as Iran war-related disruption, falling inventories and resilient demand strain the market, the IEA said.

zh.title: 伊朗战争导致供应中断，国际能源署称柴油短缺将持续至2027年
zh.summary: 国际能源署预计，由于伊朗相关的地缘政治中断、库存下降和需求韧性，柴油供应约束将持续至2027年。这一延长的短缺威胁到依赖柴油燃料的运输和工业部门。

title: BlackRock profit jumps as resilient markets boost fees
summary: BlackRock's profit surged as rising assets under management ($15.49 trillion from $13.46 trillion year-over-year) drove higher management fee revenue. The growth reflects resilient equity markets and continued investor demand for passive investment strategies.
content: BlackRock's assets under management — which determine a large chunk of its earnings — rose to $15.49 trillion, from $13.46 trillion a year earlier.

zh.title: 贝莱德利润激增，稳健的市场推高管理费
zh.summary: 贝莱德的利润激增，因为资产管理规模上升（从同比1.346万亿美元增至1.549万亿美元）推高了管理费收入。这一增长反映了稳健的股市和投资者对被动投资策略的持续需求。

title: How Trump’s tariffs and Iran war are becoming liabilities in Michigan’s Senate race
summary: Republican candidates in competitive Michigan Senate races are distancing themselves from Trump on tariffs and Iran policy in general election advertising. The political divide suggests Trump's trade and foreign policy positions may constrain GOP candidates in key swing states.
content: Republicans are largely leaving Trump out of general election ads, with some battleground candidates breaking from him on tariffs and Iran.

zh.title: 特朗普的关税和伊朗战争如何在密歇根参议院竞选中成为负累
zh.summary: 在竞争激烈的密歇根参议院竞选中，共和党候选人在大选广告中与特朗普的关税和伊朗政策保持距离。这一政治分歧表明，特朗普的贸易和外交政策立场可能会限制共和党候选人在关键摇摆州的表现。

title: Judge indefinitely blocks Trump White House from banning 3 media outlets
summary: A federal judge has indefinitely blocked the Trump administration's attempt to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN, and Politico from reporting at the White House. The ruling protects press freedom and affirms media access rights to cover the executive branch.
content: President Donald Trump had sought to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN and Politico from reporting from the White House.

zh.title: 法官无限期阻止特朗普白宫禁止3家媒体
zh.summary: 联邦法官已无限期阻止特朗普政府禁止《美国现在》、CNN和《政治》杂志在白宫报道的企图。该裁决维护了新闻自由，并确认了媒体的白宫采访权。

title: China's exports and imports surge past expectations in September
summary: China's customs agency released September trade data showing both exports and imports surpassed expectations. The stronger-than-anticipated trade figures signal solid economic momentum despite domestic slowdown concerns.
content: The country's customs agency released September trade data on Wednesday.

zh.title: 中国9月出口和进口激增，超过预期
zh.summary: 中国海关发布的9月贸易数据显示出口和进口均超过预期。这些超预期的贸易数据表明，尽管国内增长放缓，但经济动力仍保持强劲。

title: China's producer prices rise at fastest pace since June 2022, beating expectations
summary: China's producer prices rose at their fastest pace since June 2022, exceeding economist forecasts of 4.5% and the previous month's 3.8%. The increase signals growing inflationary pressures in manufacturing and production sectors.
content: The increase was higher than the 4.5% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and higher than the 3.8% seen in the previous month.

zh.title: 中国生产者价格创2022年6月以来最大涨幅，超过预期
zh.summary: 中国生产者价格自2022年6月以来以最快速度上升，超过了经济学家预测的4.5%和上月的3.8%。这一上升表明制造业和生产部门的通胀压力持续增长。

title: Taiwan agrees to buy 30% of gas from Alaska LNG project, Trump says
summary: President Trump announced that Taiwan has agreed to purchase 30% of gas production from an Alaska LNG project. The deal represents a significant energy partnership with geopolitical implications for US-Taiwan relations.
content: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday that Taiwan had agreed to buy 30% of the gas from a pipeline project in Alaska.

zh.title: 台湾同意购买阿拉斯加液化天然气项目30%产能，特朗普宣布
zh.summary: 特朗普宣布台湾已同意从阿拉斯加液化天然气项目购买30%的产气量。该协议代表了一项重大的能源伙伴关系，对美台关系具有地缘政治意义。

title: South Korean carmaker Hyundai plans 'strategic' investment of $15.5 billion in India by 2032
summary: Hyundai announced plans to invest $15.5 billion in India through 2032, identifying India as a strategic core market. The major commitment reflects automakers' focus on high-growth emerging markets and rising vehicle demand.
content: Korean car company Hyundai says India is a strategic core market

zh.title: 现代汽车计划到2032年向印度进行155亿美元"战略性"投资
zh.summary: 现代宣布计划到2032年在印度投资155亿美元，将印度确定为战略核心市场。这一重大承诺反映了汽车制造商对高增长新兴市场和不断增长的车辆需求的关注。

title: Oil rises amid growing Mideast tensions between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia
summary: Oil prices rose as escalating tensions between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia raised concerns over potential Middle East supply disruptions. Geopolitical instability in the region continues to influence global energy markets.
content: Worries over supply disruptions due to escalating tensions in the Middle East helped to push oil prices higher.

zh.title: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间中东局势升温，油价上升
zh.summary: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间的紧张局势升级，引发了对中东潜在供应中断的担忧，油价随之上升。该地区地缘政治不稳定局势继续影响全球能源市场。

title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await consumer inflation report: Live updates
summary: Stock futures remained little changed as investors awaited a consumer inflation report, while weakness in chip stocks and mixed bank earnings weighed on major indices. Economic data releases continue to drive market sentiment ahead of the inflation data.
content: A slide in chip stocks and mixed bank results on Tuesday weighed on the major averages.

zh.title: 股指期货涨跌不大，交易员等待消费者物价报告：实时更新
zh.summary: 股指期货基本持平，投资者等待消费者物价报告发布，芯片股疲软和银行业绩不佳对主要股指造成压力。在物价数据前夕，经济数据持续推动市场情绪。

title: Anthropic urges court in Washington, D.C. to rehear appeal of Pentagon blacklisting
summary: Anthropic petitioned a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal of the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models. The case highlights ongoing regulatory scrutiny and security concerns surrounding AI technology in government procurement.
content: Anthropic is asking a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal in a case concerning the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models.

zh.title: Anthropic敦促华盛顿特区法院重新听证对五角大楼黑名单的上诉
zh.summary: Anthropic向华盛顿特区联邦法院请愿，要求重新听证其对五角大楼将该公司AI模型列入黑名单的上诉。该案凸显了有关政府采购AI技术的持续监管审查和安全担忧。

title: Singapore third-quarter GDP growth softens from four-year high but beats estimates
summary: Singapore's third-quarter GDP growth moderated from a four-year high but still beat economist expectations of 5% growth. The data reflects continued economic expansion in the city-state, though at a slower pace than recent quarters.
content: The GDP print beat expectations of a 5% growth from economists polled by Reuters.

zh.title: 新加坡三季度GDP增速从四年高位回落，但仍超预期
zh.summary: 新加坡第三季度GDP增长从四年高位温和放缓，但仍超过经济学家预期的5%增速。这一数据表明该城市国家经济继续扩张，尽管增速相比近期季度有所减缓。
